parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed `extension` declarations on `EnvironmentValues` spread across 5 distinct packages (`AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, `PlayerHeaderView`). The SwiftUI pattern of extending `EnvironmentValues` in the file that owns the corresponding key is idiomatic and intentional — each extension adds domain-specific keys (e.g., `PlaylistServiceEnvironment.swift`, `AccentColorEnvironment.swift`, `RadioPlayerControllerEnvironment.swift`) that are unrelated to one another. The `fields_or_signature` arrays are all empty, so there is no evidence of shared members that could be consolidated. Merging these extensions would couple unrelated packages and violate the single-responsibility principle without any structural benefit.
